description: PGEE_Zones d'infiltration is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Jura. Les zones d'infiltration établies dans le cadre des PGEE indiquent les possibilités d'infiltration des eaux pluviales par rapport à la géologie notamment. Cette couche est indicative, les capacité réelles d'infiltration doivent être vérifiées localement (par un essai d'infiltration par rexemple). Coverage: Kanton Jura. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Jura. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, WMS, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
